description: This file defines the class QueryGenerator, which constructs SQL queries for retrieving data in a CRM system, handling filters, joins, and conditions for various modules.

classes.name: QueryGenerator
classes.description: A PHP class responsible for generating SQL queries for data retrieval in the CRM system, supporting customizable filters, joins, and module-specific query parts.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the QueryGenerator with module name and user context, setting up various internal data structures.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a given module, caching the result.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets internal query parts (fromClause, whereClause, query) to prepare for a new query build.

methods.name: setFields
methods.description: Sets the list of fields to be included in the query.

methods.name: getCustomViewFields
methods.description: Returns the list of custom view fields.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns the list of fields to include in the SELECT statement.

methods.name: getWhereFields
methods.description: Returns the list of fields used in WHERE conditions.

methods.name: getOwnerFieldList
methods.description: Returns the list of owner fields.

methods.name: getModuleNameFields
methods.description: Returns the name fields for a module.

methods.name: getReferenceFieldList
methods.description: Returns the list of reference fields.

methods.name: getReferenceFieldInfoList
methods.description: Returns detailed information about reference fields.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the current module name.

methods.name: getConditionalWhere
methods.description: Returns the constructed conditional WHERE clause.

methods.name: getDefaultCustomViewQuery
methods.description: Builds a default query based on the module's default custom view.

methods.name: initForDefaultCustomView
methods.description: Initializes the generator with the default custom view settings.

methods.name: initForCustomViewById
methods.description: Initializes the generator with custom view settings identified by view ID.

methods.name: getCustomViewQueryById
methods.description: Builds a query based on a specific custom view ID.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Constructs the full SQL query string based on the current configuration.

methods.name: getSQLColumn
methods.description: Returns the fully qualified SQL column name for a given field.

methods.name: getSelectClauseColumnSQL
methods.description: Builds and returns the SELECT clause with column SQL.

methods.name: getFromClause
methods.description: Constructs and returns the FROM clause with necessary JOINs.

methods.name: getWhereClause
methods.description: Constructs and returns the WHERE clause based on set conditions.

methods.name: getConditionValue
methods.description: Generates SQL representation for a condition's value depending on operator and field type.

methods.name: makeGroupSqlReplacements
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in group SQL with actual condition SQL snippets.

methods.name: isRelativeSearchOperators
methods.description: Determines if an operator is a relative date operator.

methods.name: isNumericType
methods.description: Checks if a data type is numeric.

methods.name: isStringType
methods.description: Checks if a data type is string-based.

methods.name: isDateType
methods.description: Checks if a data type is date or datetime.

methods.name: fixDateTimeValue
methods.description: Adjusts date/time values for specific fields (e.g., birthday) to include time parts.

methods.name: addCondition
methods.description: Adds a filter condition to the internal condition list.

methods.name: addRelatedModuleCondition
methods.description: Adds a related module condition for many-to-many relationships.

methods.name: getConditionalArray
methods.description: Creates a conditional array structure for a field, value, and operator.

methods.name: startGroup
methods.description: Starts a new group of conditions with an optional group type.

methods.name: endGroup
methods.description: Ends the current group of conditions.

methods.name: addConditionGlue
methods.description: Adds a logical operator (AND/OR) between conditions.

methods.name: addUserSearchConditions
methods.description: Adds search filters based on user input, supporting advanced, dashboard, and simple searches.

methods.name: getDashBoardConditionList
methods.description: Builds conditions based on dashboard filters sent via request.

methods.name: initForGlobalSearchByType
methods.description: Sets up conditions for a global search by field type, value, and operator.
